essays.text: 請將 IACS Rec. 2005/Rev.1 2017, 2.1.2 的敘述譯為中文：（底線字須寫出正確中文）（20 分）The Special/Renewal Survey concentrates on examination in association with thicknessdetermination. The report of the thickness measurement is recommended to be retained onboard. Protective coating condition will be recorded for particular attention during thesurvey cycle. From 1991 it is a requirement for new ships to apply a protective coating tothe structure in water ballast tanks which form part of the hull boundary, and, since 2008,all dedicated seawater ballast tanks are to be coated during construction in accordance withthe PSPC(Performance standard for protective coatings for dedicated seawater ballasttanks in all types of ships and double-side skin spaces of bulk carriers), adopted by theMaritime Safety Committee by resolution MSC.215(82).

請將下列中文譯為英文。（底線字須寫出正確英文，縮寫字須寫出完整英文）（25 分）主題：舷梯作業安全訊息：公司屬輪發生人員落海致命事件並造成我們一名船員死亡。為避免再發生舷梯作業時類似傷亡事件，請遵守下列各項以執行公司的 ISM 政策。自此生效，在船舶靠泊完成前，嚴禁舷梯作業。對船上作業，應依英國 MCA 規範之風險評估，妥善列出可能危害。對舷梯作業，請遵照英國 MCA 所發佈之 COSWP 第 15.2 章及 CK-FLT-0706-3‘舷外及高空工作許可’之指引。根據英國 MCA 要求，舷梯滾輪必須置放於碼頭，便於人員上下船時減少舷梯鋼纜張力。根據公司指令，舷梯鋼纜及其他活動零件必須經常上油與更換。
